name: Mắm Cù Lao Chàm
summary: Mắm is the sauce islanders like with the rice, though many kitchens no longer keep a jar through the storm season. A few households still make it for visitors.
origin: Cham Islands. A household sauce on Tân Hiệp, no longer a jar in every kitchen.
howToEat: On the side of the seafood rice, if a household is still selling it.
A 3 March 2026 note still has forest greens dipped in mắm cái with chili and garlic. A 2025 account lists mắm cái among foods people rarely use now. Both stay.
seoTitle: Mắm Cù Lao Chàm — island fish sauce
seoDescription: Fish sauce a few households on Tân Hiệp still make for visitors. Many kitchens no longer keep a jar through the storm season.
